environment: Local loopback HTTP benchmark inside the build container (single uvicorn worker, no GPU, shared vCPU sandbox)
note: This is full HTTP round-trip latency (serialization + FastAPI routing + feature transform + XGBoost inference + SHAP-free predict path), not raw model.predict_proba latency. Raw model inference latency alone was measured separately at ~0.18ms p50 (see docs/baseline_comparison_MEASURED.csv, xgboost row) -- the gap is HTTP/ASGI overhead, expected for a single-worker dev server on shared hardware, not representative of a tuned production deployment (multiple workers, connection pooling, gRPC, etc.).
